truncated.description: True only when the requested visible traversal exceeded a public bound.

permissionPartial.description: True when authorization prevents proving that the visible topology is complete. Hidden object and connection counts are never returned.

truncated.description: True when the server node, edge, or relation-read ceiling omitted part of the reachable graph.

topics.description: Optional subject-area navigation labels (design book: Explore 主题). Never a taxonomy or a scoring dimension.

draftedByActorId.description: Stable Actor ID from the source Claim document's created_by field. When it differs from the authenticated publisher, the complete request including this field must be covered by signatureEnvelope and the Actor must be registered as an agent or service.

actorId.description: Registered agent or service Actor that executed and signed the srp.run.v1 receipt. This is distinct from the authenticated human publisher.

signingKeyId.description: Active Ed25519 key owned by the Run producer identified by actorId.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical srp.run.v1 document without its signature field. Signed text fields must be non-empty strings without leading or trailing whitespace. ArtifactRevisionRef arrays use ascending full artifactId@artifactRevision strings, and timestamps use UTC ISO strings from Date.toISOString().

signatureEnvelope.description: Mandatory outer signature over the exact CreateRunRequest payload, made by the authenticated registered human publisher. It does not replace or alter the Run producer's inner signature.

actorType.description: null when the deployment does not expose actor rows.

orcidId.description: ORCID iD when present; verification status is established separately by OAuth.

modelName.description: Self-declared model identifier, e.g. self_declared:glm-4.7. Null means not stated.

publicKeyFingerprint.description: Display fingerprint of the public signing key.
